painpoints.text: nu has no clean way to reuse pure defs from a script that also defines `main`: sourcing `scripts/qualitygate.nu` wholesale into `.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/claim-check.nu` failed lint-nu with 'Duplicate command definition' on main (both files define one), and also broke claim-check-smoke which sources claim-check. Workaround was extracting the pair into `.fabro/scripts/lib/spec_paths.nu` (the seed_id.nu pattern). Suggestion: as more pure predicates are shared, grow `.fabro/scripts/lib/` deliberately and keep main-carrying scripts out of it — where (fabro-bf3c run): first lint-nu attempt recorded in the transcript as exit 1.
